name: strongman barbell farmers walk
description: Walking while carrying a heavy loaded bar at your sides. Builds grip strength, upper back and trunk stability.
instructions: Stand inside the loaded bar and grip the handle, then lift it to hang at your sides.
Keep your chest tall, shoulders back and core braced.
Walk forward with short, quick steps for a set distance.
Stop, lower the weights to the floor with a flat back, and rest.
